name: Badb

facts.text: Level 70, 30,000 health, in the Bog of Cullen. She appears only at night; by day she cannot be seen or targeted.
She calls three raven wraiths and casts Voices of Pain (400 cold).
Badb is a war goddess who appears as a crow over battlefields.
Bot chat: a crow of war nesting in the Bog of Cullen, who smells battles coming.

story:
In the old songs Badb was a war goddess who flew over battles as a hooded crow and screamed until men lost their nerve. Whether the Badb of the Bog of Cullen is that one, worn thin by the ages, or only something that took her name, the Cullen folk do not argue. She wakes at dusk. By day her nest is empty and the crows sit quiet; at night she is there, and her voice is the cold scream of every battle she remembers. Three ravens that are not quite birds come down at her call. The frontier guards say she has been restless every evening since the keeps began to change hands.

She is older than the courts, the druids say, older than the Veil: a power of the bog country who was here before anyone came to fight over it. In the old songs she flew over battles as a hooded crow, screaming until men lost their nerve, and at Mag Tuired, some tellings say, she fought on the side of the Tuatha. Whatever she was then, the Badb of the Bog of Cullen is thin with age and hungry for the thing she was made for.

By day her nest is empty and the crows sit quiet on the posts of the Cullen road. At dusk she is there, and the crows all turn to face the same way. Her voice is the cold scream of every battle she remembers, a Voice of Pain that freezes the blood of whoever she turns it on. Three raven wraiths that are not quite birds come down when she calls, and she does not stray far from her nest. The frontier guards say she has been restless every evening since the keeps began to change hands; she can smell the realm war from the bog.
legend: Night only: do not bother looking for her by day. When she pulls, three raven wraiths come with her; kill them or hold them while the rest burn her. Her scream is cold damage over the group, so spread and keep cold resists. Do not drag her far from her nest. Superstitions: never whistle on the Cullen road after dusk; count the crows on the posts, and if they all face one way, go home. Nicknames: 'the crow', 'the bog wife'. She keeps hours, so plan the pull for night. Bring a bard to sing over the crow. Never kill a crow on the Cullen road. Ever.

loremasterTopic.text: The war-crow of the Bog of Cullen, who wakes at dusk and smells battle coming. Three raven wraiths come at her call.

bookPage: From Derbáil of Ardee's list: the Cullen road after dusk. Grandmother said you can tell when the crow is awake, because every crow on every post turns to face the bog together. She said Badb was there before the first Hibernian built a fire, and that she flew over Mag Tuired screaming and the Fomorians broke. She is thin now, grandmother said, the way old fires are thin, but she still wakes at dusk, and she can smell a war from a long way off. In the years the keeps change hands most, the crows face the bog every single night.
